fields.title: {{sign}} Season
fields.summary: {{sign}} Season puts attention on the way this sign handles life in real time. Notice which conversation, decision, or pattern keeps asking for a clearer response.
fields.body: The Sun sets the larger tone of the season. In {{sign}}, attention moves through {{signStyle}}. This is a current collective theme, so the writing should name what people may notice and what to do with it.
fields.bestMove: Choose one question, conversation, or next step that makes the season useful instead of vague.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: Moon in {{sign}}
fields.summary: The Moon in {{sign}} can make the day feel filtered through {{signStyle}}. Needs, moods, and reactions may become easier to read when you slow the first response down.
fields.body: The Moon describes what people reach for quickly: comfort, safety, memory, appetite, mood, and reaction. In {{sign}}, those needs tend to move through {{signStyle}}. If the day feels reactive, start by naming the need before deciding what to do with it.
fields.bestMove: Pause before answering. Separate the feeling from the fact, then choose the response that still makes sense later.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{planet}} in {{sign}}
fields.summary: {{planet}} moving through {{sign}} brings {{planetTopic}} into a {{signStyle}} style. Watch where that topic shows up in ordinary decisions.
fields.body: The planet names the topic. The sign describes the condition it is moving through. With {{planet}} in {{sign}}, {{planetTopic}} may come through {{signStyle}}. Write this as current sky timing, not natal identity.
fields.bestMove: Pick one concrete response connected to {{planetTopic}}: ask the question, make the edit, set the boundary, schedule the next step, or wait until the facts are clearer.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{planetA}} {{aspect}} {{planetB}}
fields.summary: {{planetA}} and {{planetB}} are in contact, so two themes may need to be read together before the day makes sense.
fields.body: {{planetA}} brings {{planetATopic}}. {{planetB}} brings {{planetBTopic}}. Through a {{aspect}} aspect, these topics may blend, contrast, cooperate, or create friction depending on the aspect. The useful move is not to over-explain the feeling. Name both sides, then make the next step smaller and clearer.
fields.bestMove: Ask what is actually being mixed together here. Then choose the action that addresses both sides without letting one take over.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{planet}} Retrograde
fields.summary: {{planet}} retrograde turns attention back toward {{planetTopic}}. The point is not panic or reversal; it is review, revision, and a slower look at what has been running on momentum.
fields.body: Retrograde periods often make a planet's topic less linear. With {{planet}} retrograde, {{planetTopic}} may need more checking, revisiting, or patience. What looks like delay can also reveal where the original plan was too thin.
fields.bestMove: Review before you escalate. Recheck the facts, repeat the conversation if needed, and give the process room to show what needs correction.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: Natal {{planet}} in {{sign}}
fields.summary: You may notice {{planetTopic}} expressing through {{signStyle}}. This can describe a recurring tendency, not a fixed identity.
fields.body: In a birth chart, {{planet}} describes {{planetTopic}}. {{sign}} describes the style or condition through which that part of life tends to operate. This may show up as a familiar way of choosing, reacting, wanting, protecting, or making meaning.
fields.bestMove: Keep the strength without letting the habit run automatically. Notice where this pattern helps, then choose the response that fits the present situation.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: Natal {{planetA}} {{aspect}} {{planetB}}
fields.summary: This aspect describes a recurring relationship between {{planetATopic}} and {{planetBTopic}}. You may notice it most when both needs are active at once.
fields.body: A natal aspect is a pattern between two parts of life. {{planetA}} brings {{planetATopic}}. {{planetB}} brings {{planetBTopic}}. The {{aspect}} describes how those parts tend to meet, whether through fusion, contrast, friction, support, or flow.
fields.bestMove: Name both parts before choosing. The pattern becomes easier to work with when neither side has to carry the whole story.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{transitPlanet}} {{aspect}} Natal {{natalPoint}}
fields.summary: A current movement of {{transitPlanetTopic}} is contacting your natal {{natalPoint}} pattern. This is timing, not destiny.
fields.body: Transits describe what is being activated now. Your natal {{natalPoint}} already carries a pattern connected to {{natalPointTopic}}. As {{transitPlanet}} contacts it, that part of life may become louder through events, moods, conversations, choices, or pressure to respond.
fields.bestMove: Treat it as a short window for noticing the pattern and choosing the cleanest next step. Do not make the transit bigger than the actual situation.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{personA}}'s {{planetA}} {{aspect}} {{personB}}'s {{planetB}}
fields.summary: This contact describes one way the connection gets attention. One person's {{planetATopic}} meets the other person's {{planetBTopic}}.
fields.body: Synastry describes what happens between two charts. This contact may feel easy, charged, familiar, confusing, or motivating depending on the aspect and the people involved. It is most useful when it explains an interaction pattern, not when it turns either person into the problem.
fields.bestMove: Name the dynamic as something happening between you. Then decide what would make the exchange cleaner, kinder, or easier to handle.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{personA}}'s {{planet}} in {{personB}}'s {{house}} House
fields.summary: This overlay shows where {{personA}} may activate {{personB}}'s {{houseLifeArea}}. The planet brings a topic; the house shows where it lands.
fields.body: House overlays describe the part of life that gets stirred in the other person's chart. {{planet}} brings {{planetTopic}} into {{houseLifeArea}}. This can feel supportive, exposing, energizing, or complicated depending on the rest of the connection.
fields.bestMove: Use the house as context. Ask whether this person is activating a real life area, not just a mood.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: Composite {{planetA}} {{aspect}} {{planetB}}
fields.summary: This composite aspect describes a pattern that belongs to the relationship itself. It is less about either person alone and more about what the bond tends to create.
fields.body: A composite chart treats the relationship as its own system. {{planetA}} brings {{planetATopic}}. {{planetB}} brings {{planetBTopic}}. The {{aspect}} describes how those themes operate inside the connection: what comes easily, what repeats, and where the relationship may need more conscious handling.
fields.bestMove: Ask what the relationship tends to produce when both people are together. Work with the pattern instead of assigning it to one person.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: Composite {{planet}} in {{sign}}
fields.summary: This placement describes how {{planetTopic}} tends to operate inside the relationship itself, especially through the {{house}} house area.
fields.body: Composite placements describe the relationship as its own living pattern. {{planet}} names the relationship topic. {{sign}} describes the style it moves through. The {{house}} house shows where that pattern becomes concrete in the bond.
fields.bestMove: Read this as a shared pattern. Ask what the relationship tends to create here, then choose the behavior that makes the pattern easier to live with.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{transitPlanet}} {{aspect}} {{person}}'s {{natalPoint}}
fields.summary: Current timing may be pressing on {{person}}'s {{natalPointTopic}}. Before assuming the issue is the relationship, check what this transit is stirring in their chart.
fields.body: Relationship timing is often easier to read when each person's current pressure is named separately. This transit brings {{transitPlanetTopic}} into contact with {{person}}'s {{natalPointTopic}}. Their mood, priorities, or availability may shift while that pattern is active.
fields.bestMove: Start with the activated life area. Ask what is being stirred, what support is useful, and what does not need to be taken personally.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: One question is moving through different lives
fields.summary: More than one person in this group may be moving through {{topic}} right now, but that does not mean they are living the same story.
fields.body: This update looks for repeated timing across multiple charts. When the same topic appears for more than one person, it can describe a shared mood in the group without making everyone's experience identical. One person may meet it through a conversation, another through a deadline, a boundary, a money question, a health issue, or the need for privacy before they can explain what is happening.
fields.bestMove: Name the shared pattern, then keep the response practical: clarify plans, ask directly, lower assumptions, or give people room where the timing calls for it.
fields.emptyState: If no approved content exists, leave the product surface blank.

fields.title: {{lifeArea}}
fields.summary: Use this focus to prioritize astrology connected to {{lifeAreaDescription}}.
fields.body: When this is turned on, TLDR Astro can surface more cards related to {{lifeAreaDescription}}. It does not make the topic more important in your chart; it simply helps the app choose what to show first.
fields.bestMove: Turn it on when this topic is actively on your mind. Turn it off when you want a broader read.
fields.emptyState: Choose the areas of life you want the app to prioritize.

fields.summary: This contact is hard to miss because the two parts of the chart keep showing up together.
fields.advice: Give the chemistry time to show its shape before making the whole relationship about this one contact.
fields.actionLine: Give the contact room without letting it take over the whole relationship.

fields.summary: This contact can feel magnetic and exposing because each person may carry one side of the pattern.
fields.advice: Do not rush to decide who is right. Slow the conversation down and separate the feeling from the assumption.
fields.actionLine: Slow the reaction down and name what each person is protecting, wanting, or assuming.

fields.summary: This contact tends to feel natural. It can make the connection easier to trust because less translation is needed.
fields.advice: Use the ease instead of leaving it vague. Say what you appreciate, make the plan, or let the support become visible.
fields.actionLine: Use the ease on purpose. Say the supportive thing, make the simple plan, or let the trust become an action.

fields.body: Jupiter sextile Moon may make it easier to ask for what you need. This can help with comfort, generosity, support, or an honest emotional response, as long as you do not treat a good feeling like a final answer.
Jupiter square Chiron can make confidence and old hurt rub against each other. A bigger opportunity may bring up an old fear of not being ready, not being chosen, or not knowing enough.
Mars sextile Mercury can help you say what needs to be said and act on a decision more quickly. It is useful for direct conversations, problem-solving, and turning an idea into a next step.

Venus opposite Pluto can make relationships, money, or desire feel more charged than usual. Watch for control, jealousy, obsession, or the need to know where you stand before the situation is actually clear.

Chiron sextile North Node can make an old sensitivity easier to understand without letting it decide the whole story. A small repair, honest conversation, or different choice may point you toward what needs to grow next.
Moon trine Mars can help your reaction and your next move line up more naturally. This can be useful for what you feel and what you do next, especially if you act before the feeling gets stale.
Moon sextile Mercury can make it easier to put a feeling into words. A message, decision, or conversation may help clarify what you need.

fields.headline: Conversations may blur today.
fields.notice: Conversations can blur today. You may think you said one thing while someone else hears another, or a message may land in a tone nobody intended.
fields.why: Mercury describes how information moves. Neptune softens boundaries, so facts, impressions, memories, and wishes can slide into each other. The square can make it harder to separate what is being said from what is actually clear.
fields.move: Get important details in writing. Ask the clarifying question before reacting, and wait before making a decision that depends on certainty.

fields.headline: Try a different response today.
fields.notice: Your usual reaction may not fit today. A feeling can change quickly, or something small may interrupt the plan you thought you were following.
fields.why: The Moon describes instinct and immediate need. Uranus brings disruption, freedom, and the urge to break pattern. A trine can make the change easier to use if you do not treat the first reaction as the only option.
fields.move: Try a different response before repeating the old one. Take enough space to think clearly, then make one practical adjustment.

fields.headline: Turn one idea into action.
fields.notice: The day can make scattered ideas easier to organize. If your attention has been split across too many choices, one useful next step may become clearer.
fields.why: The Sun shows where attention is going. Saturn adds structure, discipline, and reality checks. A sextile is an opening, so focus is available if you choose one concrete place to put it.
fields.move: Narrow the field. Pick the idea with the clearest next step and put it on a timeline.

fields.headline: Affection may need proof today.
fields.notice: Affection may feel more believable when it shows up through actions. Empty reassurance may not land as well as consistency, follow-through, or a practical gesture.
fields.why: Venus describes affection, pleasure, and value. Saturn asks for proof, patience, and maturity. The contact can make care feel more serious, but also more trustworthy when it is backed by action.
fields.move: Look for care in actions, not only in words. Let consistency matter more than a quick reassurance.

fields.headline: Do not force what needs patience.
fields.notice: Effort may meet a limit today. Pushing harder can waste energy if the timing, structure, or responsibility underneath the action has not been handled.
fields.why: Mars wants movement. Saturn slows things down until the structure is strong enough to hold the effort. The aspect can feel frustrating, but it is useful for choosing the action that will actually work.
fields.move: Move slowly enough to avoid wasting energy. Choose the task that can actually be completed.

fields.headline: Comfort may be easier to reach.
fields.notice: Comfort may be easier to name today. A small act of care, beauty, food, rest, or reassurance can do more than a big emotional conversation.
fields.why: The Moon describes need and response. Venus describes pleasure, ease, and affection. The contact can make it easier to understand what would feel supportive in a simple, concrete way.
fields.move: Make comfort concrete. Say what would feel supportive instead of hoping the other person guesses.

fields.headline: Say the practical thing clearly.
fields.notice: The practical conversation may be the one that helps most today. Details, timing, and limits can make a message clearer instead of colder.
fields.why: Mercury handles words and decisions. Saturn brings limits, time, and responsibility. The contact favors clarity over performance.
fields.move: Keep the message simple. Say what is true, what is possible, and what needs more time.

fields.headline: Desire may need better timing.
fields.notice: Attraction and urgency can get tangled today. Wanting something does not automatically mean the timing is right.
fields.why: Venus wants connection and pleasure. Mars wants action and desire. The aspect can show where attraction needs timing, consent, or a cleaner choice.
fields.move: Notice the difference between attraction and urgency. Let desire move, but do not let it make the whole decision.

fields.headline: Do not rush to believe the story.
fields.notice: The story may be softer than the facts today. Inspiration is possible, but so is seeing what you want to see.
fields.why: The Sun brings attention. Neptune brings imagination, longing, and blur. The contact can inspire, but it can also make the obvious facts harder to hold.
fields.move: Check the facts before committing to the story. Inspiration is useful, but only if it can survive a little daylight.

fields.headline: A feeling may run deeper than expected.
fields.notice: A reaction may carry more history than the moment explains. The feeling may be real, but it may not be only about what just happened.
fields.why: The Moon describes emotional need. Pluto brings depth, control, fear, and transformation. The contact can pull a feeling up from underneath the surface.
fields.move: Do not dismiss the feeling just because it is intense. Name what is underneath it before trying to control it.
